meta.question: Is there a COMMERCIAL DATASHEET for a Ni/MgAl2O4 steam-reforming CATALYST?
meta.answer: NO. Commercial datasheets were found for MgAl2O4 SPINEL SUPPORT POWDERS only. No supplier sheet giving Ni wt%, loaded pellet bulk density, crush strength and service life for a Ni/MgAl2O4 reforming catalyst was found in open sources.
meta.status: [НЕ ПОДТВЕРЖДЕНО] for the catalyst datasheet; [ПОДТВЕРЖДЕНО] for the support powders
meta.consequence: The JM KATALCO alpha-Al2O3 / Ca-aluminate PROXY (900 kg/m3, 16-18 wt% NiO, >8-10 y) REMAINS in cases/config.json. Powder bulk density 300 g/L is NOT a loaded-pellet density and must NOT be substituted for it.
